notes.title: v1.0.3 Shortcut Buttons Patch
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

I've got another patch for you that adds some little things, so here's the patch notes:

[list]
    [*]Added version number to the game (it can be found on the Options screen)
    [*]You can now use the scroll wheel on the mouse to change between magnet types
    [*]You can now press the space bar to launch all spawners (double clicking does this too!)
    [*]Keyboard shortcuts / mouse wheel are now usable in the Level Editor
    [*]Fixed crash bug when removing a bounce back magnet at the wrong time
[/list]

I'm still working on some things so expect more patches soon!

Benn

notes.title: v1.0.1 "Whoops I broke the game" Patch
notes.content:
Hey all!

I'm rolling out a patch across all platforms to try and control the "AL.OUT_OF_MEMORY: OpenAL has run out of memory" bug that I accidentally introduced to the game just before launching (mega oops).

The crash isn't entirely eradicated yet, but it should be heavily reduced so you have to play for a lot longer before the crash happens. 

If you do encounter the crash, all you have to do is relaunch the game.

Please let me know in the discussions if you encounter any other issues!

Benn

tags.bug: - AL.OUT_OF_MEMORY: OpenAL has run out of memory
